_comment: Source of truth for the CURRENT AIRBDS assessment-skill release on each channel. The assessment skill fetches this at runtime to tell a user when a newer skill — one that assesses against a newer AIRBDS metric version — is available for THEIR OWN channel. A skill compares only against its own channel: a 'testing' skill is never nudged because 'development' has moved ahead. Update this file whenever a channel's released skill starts targeting a new metric version (see skills/README.md).
_comment_urls: The 'testing' and 'development' skill_update_urls point at airbds-dev because those channels are development artifacts: the build workflows in this repo publish their zips as releases HERE. 'production' points at the publication repo (AIBIO-UK/airbds-core), which is where the production zip actually lives — it is published there by skills/src/scripts/release_skill_to_core.sh and exists nowhere else, so there is no second copy to drift. Note that the MANIFEST ITSELF still lives here and is still served from the raw_url below: that URL is baked into every published skill, so do not repoint it until airbds-core actually hosts this file. Note too that AIBIO-UK/airbds-metric now redirects to airbds-core, so an old URL resolves to the publication repo rather than to this one; a redirect is not a substitute for the file actually being there.
